description: Dati di traffico is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Piemonte. Dati di traffico orario distinto per direzione e per classe veicolare, per il mese di ottobre 2019, raccolti da tutte le postazioni della mobilità veicolare. Per consultare in modo completo il dataset è possibile metterlo in relazione, tramite il campo chiave (ID), con il dataset Anagrafica dati di traffico. Coverage: Regione Piemonte. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Piemonte. Its tags are orario, traffico, trasporto, veicolo. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
